map.维保周期和年检周期有什么区别？: What is the difference between the maintenance cycle and the annual inspection cycle?
map.维保是日常半月保或月保（15 天或 30 天一次），年检是特种设备定期检验（通常: Maintenance is the routine half-monthly or monthly service (every 15 or 30 days), while the annual inspection is the periodic inspection of special equipment (usually once a year). Both need reminders before they fall due and neither replaces the other.
map.逾期未检会有什么后果？: What are the consequences of an overdue inspection?
map.电梯超期未检属违规运行，监管部门可责令停用并处罚款；台账里的逾期标记用于倒逼及时: Operating an elevator past its inspection due date is a violation; regulators can order it out of service and impose fines. The overdue flag in the ledger pushes timely scheduling to avoid running in a defective state.
